review.tagline: Terminal coding agent with extensions, skills, and an SDK
review.summary: Pi is a TypeScript coding agent CLI that runs in your project directory and connects to LLM providers through a login or API key. It is customized with extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes, shared as npm or git packages, and can be driven interactively, in print/JSON mode, over RPC, or through a TypeScript SDK. The monorepo also ships a multi-provider LLM API, an agent runtime and a terminal UI library.
review.audience: Developers who want a scriptable, customizable terminal coding agent
strengths: Multiple interfaces: interactive CLI, print/JSON mode, RPC and a TypeScript SDK
Extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes ship as npm or git packages
Core libraries (pi-ai, pi-agent-core, pi-tui) are published as separate packages
Installer pins dependencies; Nix flake builds on Linux and macOS, ARM64 and x86-64
weaknesses: No built-in permission system; runs with the launching user's full permissions
Sub-agents and plan mode are intentionally omitted and must be added via packages
New contributors' issues and PRs are auto-closed by default
needs: Needs Node.js 22.19+, LLM provider API key or subscription
